# Dry Run Array Problems

[← Meta](../README.md) · [Every Meta question](../../meta.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/26fce5a4-6e36-4018-a807-81296258e4e4)

---

Given an integer array `nums`, produce, at every index `i`, the product of every value in `nums` other than `nums[i]`. The solution must avoid division and run in O(n) time. Also, given a two-dimensional grid containing 0s and 1s, compute one generation of the game of life. Every cell is affected by its eight surrounding cells—horizontal, vertical, and diagonal—according to these conditions:

1. A living cell remains alive when it has two or three living neighbors.
2. A living cell dies when it has fewer than two or greater than three living neighbors.
3. A nonliving cell becomes alive when exactly three of its neighbors are living.

For a provided starting matrix, return the matrix representing the following state.
